sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT
COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS TotalAssets,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed' THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS Deployed,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN BE.`Reconciliation Identity` IS NULL OR BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = '' THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS MissingIdentity
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE

WHERE BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')
AND ('__all' IN (${AssetType:singlequote}) OR BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN (${AssetType:singlequote}))
AND (${Lifecycle:singlequote} = 'All stages' OR BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = ${Lifecycle:singlequote})
AND (
 ('__all' IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}) AND ${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships')
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP
 WHERE AP.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
 AND ('__all' IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}) OR AP.`Full Name` IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}))
 AND (${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships' OR AP.`PersonRole` = ${Relationship:singlequote}))
)

sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT
COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS TotalAssets,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` A WHERE A.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND A.`PersonRole` = 'Owned by') THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS NoOwner,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` A WHERE A.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND A.`PersonRole` = 'Supported by') THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS NoSupport,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` A WHERE A.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND A.`PersonRole` = 'Managed by') THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS NoManager,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` A WHERE A.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND A.`PersonRole` = 'Owned by') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` A WHERE A.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND A.`PersonRole` = 'Supported by') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` A WHERE A.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND A.`PersonRole` = 'Managed by') THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS Unassigned
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE

WHERE BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')
AND ('__all' IN (${AssetType:singlequote}) OR BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN (${AssetType:singlequote}))
AND (${Lifecycle:singlequote} = 'All stages' OR BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = ${Lifecycle:singlequote})
AND (
 ('__all' IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}) AND ${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships')
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP
 WHERE AP.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
 AND ('__all' IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}) OR AP.`Full Name` IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}))
 AND (${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships' OR AP.`PersonRole` = ${Relationship:singlequote}))
)

sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT
COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS TotalAssets,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:Contract-CIAssociations` C WHERE C.CI_Recon_ID = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND C.`Contract ID+` IS NOT NULL) THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS NoContract,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:Contract-CIAssociations` C WHERE C.CI_Recon_ID = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND C.`Contract ID+` IS NOT NULL AND C.`Expiration Date` IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF('day',CurrentDate(),C.`Expiration Date`) > 0) THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS FutureDated,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:Contract-CIAssociations` C WHERE C.CI_Recon_ID = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND C.`Contract ID+` IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:Contract-CIAssociations` C WHERE C.CI_Recon_ID = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND C.`Contract ID+` IS NOT NULL AND C.`Expiration Date` IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF('day',CurrentDate(),C.`Expiration Date`) > 0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:Contract-CIAssociations` C WHERE C.CI_Recon_ID = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND C.`Contract ID+` IS NOT NULL AND C.`Expiration Date` IS NULL) THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS UnknownExpiry,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:Contract-CIAssociations` C WHERE C.CI_Recon_ID = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND C.`Contract ID+` IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:Contract-CIAssociations` C WHERE C.CI_Recon_ID = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND C.`Contract ID+` IS NOT NULL AND C.`Expiration Date` IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF('day',CurrentDate(),C.`Expiration Date`) > 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:Contract-CIAssociations` C WHERE C.CI_Recon_ID = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND C.`Contract ID+` IS NOT NULL AND C.`Expiration Date` IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:Contract-CIAssociations` C WHERE C.CI_Recon_ID = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND C.`Contract ID+` IS NOT NULL AND C.`Expiration Date` IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF('day',CurrentDate(),C.`Expiration Date`) <= 0) THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS PastDatedOnly
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE

WHERE BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')
AND ('__all' IN (${AssetType:singlequote}) OR BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN (${AssetType:singlequote}))
AND (${Lifecycle:singlequote} = 'All stages' OR BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = ${Lifecycle:singlequote})
AND (
 ('__all' IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}) AND ${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships')
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP
 WHERE AP.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
 AND ('__all' IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}) OR AP.`Full Name` IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}))
 AND (${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships' OR AP.`PersonRole` = ${Relationship:singlequote}))
)

sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT
COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS TotalAssets,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `PCT:Product Model-Version` P WHERE P.`Product Name` = BE.`Model Number` AND P.Manufacturer = BE.`Manufacturer Name+` AND (P.`Product Model/Version` = BE.`Version Number` OR (P.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN' AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL))) THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS Matched,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `PCT:Product Model-Version` P WHERE P.`Product Name` = BE.`Model Number` AND P.Manufacturer = BE.`Manufacturer Name+` AND (P.`Product Model/Version` = BE.`Version Number` OR (P.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN' AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL))) THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS Unmatched,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (BE.`Manufacturer Name+` IS NULL OR BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = '' OR BE.`Model Number` IS NULL OR BE.`Model Number` = '' OR BE.`Version Number` IS NULL OR BE.`Version Number` = '') THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS Incomplete
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE

WHERE BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')
AND ('__all' IN (${AssetType:singlequote}) OR BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN (${AssetType:singlequote}))
AND (${Lifecycle:singlequote} = 'All stages' OR BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = ${Lifecycle:singlequote})
AND (
 ('__all' IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}) AND ${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships')
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP
 WHERE AP.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
 AND ('__all' IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}) OR AP.`Full Name` IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}))
 AND (${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships' OR AP.`PersonRole` = ${Relationship:singlequote}))
)

sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT
COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS TotalAssets,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (PMV.Matches IS NULL OR PMV.Matches <> 1 OR CASE WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife` END IS NULL) THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS Unknown,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PMV.Matches = 1 AND DATEDIFF('day',CurrentDate(),CASE WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife` END) <= 0 THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS Past,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PMV.Matches = 1 AND DATEDIFF('day',CurrentDate(),CASE WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife` END) BETWEEN 1 AND 92 THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS Soon,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PMV.Matches = 1 AND DATEDIFF('day',CurrentDate(),CASE WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife` END) BETWEEN 93 AND 365 THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS Later,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PMV.Matches = 1 AND DATEDIFF('day',CurrentDate(),CASE WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife` END) > 365 THEN BE.`Instance Id` END) AS Beyond
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE
LEFT OUTER JOIN (
 SELECT `Manufacturer` AS Manufacturer, `Product Name` AS ProductName, `Product Model/Version` AS ProductVersion,
 COUNT(*) AS Matches, MAX(`EndOfExtendedSupport`) AS EndOfExtendedSupport,
 MAX(`EndOfSupport`) AS EndOfSupport, MAX(`EndOfLife`) AS EndOfLife
 FROM `PDL:ProductModelVersion`
 GROUP BY Manufacturer, ProductName, ProductVersion
) PMV ON PMV.ProductName = BE.`Model Number` AND PMV.Manufacturer = BE.`Manufacturer Name+`
AND (PMV.ProductVersion = BE.`Version Number` OR (PMV.ProductVersion = 'UNKNOWN' AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL))
WHERE BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')
AND ('__all' IN (${AssetType:singlequote}) OR BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN (${AssetType:singlequote}))
AND (${Lifecycle:singlequote} = 'All stages' OR BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = ${Lifecycle:singlequote})
AND (
 ('__all' IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}) AND ${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships')
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP
 WHERE AP.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
 AND ('__all' IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}) OR AP.`Full Name` IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}))
 AND (${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships' OR AP.`PersonRole` = ${Relationship:singlequote}))
)

sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT
BE.Name AS Asset,
BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` AS AssetType,
BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AS Instance,
BE.`Class Id` AS Class,
CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` A WHERE A.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND A.`PersonRole` = 'Owned by') THEN 'Recorded' ELSE 'Not recorded' END AS Owner,
CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` A WHERE A.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND A.`PersonRole` = 'Supported by') THEN 'Recorded' ELSE 'Not recorded' END AS Support,
CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` A WHERE A.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND A.`PersonRole` = 'Managed by') THEN 'Recorded' ELSE 'Not recorded' END AS Manager
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE

WHERE BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')
AND ('__all' IN (${AssetType:singlequote}) OR BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN (${AssetType:singlequote}))
AND (${Lifecycle:singlequote} = 'All stages' OR BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = ${Lifecycle:singlequote})
AND (
 ('__all' IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}) AND ${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships')
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP
 WHERE AP.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
 AND ('__all' IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}) OR AP.`Full Name` IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}))
 AND (${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships' OR AP.`PersonRole` = ${Relationship:singlequote}))
)
AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` A WHERE A.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND A.`PersonRole` = 'Owned by') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` A WHERE A.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND A.`PersonRole` = 'Supported by') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` A WHERE A.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AND A.`PersonRole` = 'Managed by'))
ORDER BY BE.Name,BE.`Instance Id`
LIMIT 100

SELECT
BE.Name AS Asset,
BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` AS AssetType,
BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AS Instance,
BE.`Class Id` AS Class,
CASE WHEN (PMV.Matches IS NULL OR PMV.Matches <> 1 OR CASE WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife` END IS NULL) THEN 'Unknown / ambiguous' WHEN DATEDIFF('day',CurrentDate(),CASE WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife` END) <= 0 THEN 'Milestone passed' ELSE 'Due within 92 days' END AS PlanningState,
CASE WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife` END AS CatalogMilestone
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE
LEFT OUTER JOIN (
 SELECT `Manufacturer` AS Manufacturer, `Product Name` AS ProductName, `Product Model/Version` AS ProductVersion,
 COUNT(*) AS Matches, MAX(`EndOfExtendedSupport`) AS EndOfExtendedSupport,
 MAX(`EndOfSupport`) AS EndOfSupport, MAX(`EndOfLife`) AS EndOfLife
 FROM `PDL:ProductModelVersion`
 GROUP BY Manufacturer, ProductName, ProductVersion
) PMV ON PMV.ProductName = BE.`Model Number` AND PMV.Manufacturer = BE.`Manufacturer Name+`
AND (PMV.ProductVersion = BE.`Version Number` OR (PMV.ProductVersion = 'UNKNOWN' AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL))
WHERE BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')
AND ('__all' IN (${AssetType:singlequote}) OR BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN (${AssetType:singlequote}))
AND (${Lifecycle:singlequote} = 'All stages' OR BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = ${Lifecycle:singlequote})
AND (
 ('__all' IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}) AND ${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships')
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP
 WHERE AP.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
 AND ('__all' IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}) OR AP.`Full Name` IN (${Portfolio:singlequote}))
 AND (${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships' OR AP.`PersonRole` = ${Relationship:singlequote}))
)
AND ((PMV.Matches IS NULL OR PMV.Matches <> 1 OR CASE WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife` END IS NULL) OR DATEDIFF('day',CurrentDate(),CASE WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife` END) <= 92)
ORDER BY PlanningState,BE.Name,BE.`Instance Id`
LIMIT 100
